turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Main samajh sakta hoon ki is waqt tumhare dimaag mein kya chal raha hoga. Raat ke do baje office mein baith kar jab charo taraf khamoshi hoti hai, toh wo 5 saal ki mehnat aur ye saara bojh bahut bhari lagta hai.

Sabse pehle toh, ek gehri saans lo. Tumne jo kiya hai, wo koi choti baat nahi hai. 5 saal kisi sapne ko paalne ke liye jaan laga dena, har kisi ke bas ki baat nahi hoti. Rohit aur Sneha ka jaana, tumhare liye dardnaak zaroor hoga, par jaisa tumne kaha—tumhe bhi pata hai ki unhone apni life ke liye sahi faisla liya. Isse tumhare upar koi dosh nahi aata.

Abhi tum thake hue ho, aur ye waqt shayad bade faisle lene ka nahi hai. 

Bas ek baat yaad rakhna: tumne ye company shuru ki thi kyunki tumhare paas ek vision tha. Wo vision abhi bhi tumhare andar hai. Lekin 4 mahine ka runway aur salary na lena... ye ek bahut lamba aur thaka dene wala raasta hai. Khud ko burn-out hone se bachana zaroori hai.

Kya tumne socha hai ki in agle 4 mahino mein tumhara goal kya hai? Is it to pivot, to sell, or to just find closure? 

Thodi der aankhen band karo. Aaj raat office mein rukne ka koi fayda nahi agar tum kaam nahi kar rahe. Ghar jao, thoda rest lo. Kal subah jab dimaag thoda shaant hoga, tab shayad tumhe dikhega ki aage ka rasta kya hai. Tum akele nahi ho, aur ye failure tumhari pehchan nahi hai. Tumne bahut himmat dikhayi hai, aur wo himmat abhi bhi tumhare saath hai. 

Thoda paani piyo aur nikal jao yahan se. Ghar jaakar so jao, please?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Ye "fake it till you make it" wala mode sabse zyada thaka dene wala hota hai, hai na? Jab tumhe pata hai ki floor neeche se khisak raha hai, par tumhe captain banke ship sambhalni hai... wo acting insaan ko andar se tod deti hai.

Tum jo mehsoos kar rahe ho, wo bahut insaani hai. Jo tumne kaha—"apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon"—ye wo moment hai jahan tumhara subconscious tumse keh raha hai ki bas, ab aur acting nahi ho sakti.

Sunn, ek dost ki tarah bol raha hoon: **Jo juniors tumhare saath ruke hain, wo tumhare liye nahi ruke, wo tumhare vision ke liye ruke hain.** Unhe bhi pata hai ki kya chal raha hai. Aaj kal ke employees bahut smart hote hain, unhe sab dikhta hai. Agar wo ruke hain, toh shayad unhe tumhari leadership, ya tumhare saath kaam karne ka maza, ya phir us project mein abhi bhi kuch umeed dikh rahi hogi. Unhe "career jala raha hoon" keh kar khud ko itna mat kos. Tumne unhe force nahi kiya hai.

Par wo "do voices" wali problem... wo sabse dangerous hai. Ghar pe sacchayi aur office mein jhooth, ye tumhe andar se khokhla kar dega.

Kya tumne kabhi socha hai ki "transparency" try karo? Maybe not with everyone, but with your co-founder? Shayad wo bhi wahi acting kar raha ho, aur tum dono ek doosre ke saamne ye mask utaarne ke liye tadap rahe ho? Kabhi kabhi jab hum sach bol dete hain ki "bhai, mujhe nahi pata aage kya hoga," toh wazan kam ho jata hai.

Tumhe lag raha hai ki tumhe sab sambhalna hai, par shayad tum akela ye bojh utha kar galti kar rahe ho.  

Aaj raat tum wahan baithe ho, shayad isliye kyunki tumhare dimaag mein ye saare scenarios chal rahe hain. Lekin ek baat bata—agar tum kal subah unse ye keh do ki "Dekho, halat kharab hain, hume pivot/wind-up karna pad sakta hai, main tumhare career ke liye concerned hoon," toh kya hoga? 

Sabse bura kya ho sakta hai? Wo chale jayenge. Par kam se kam tumhara conscience saaf ho jayega. Tum unhe "jalne" se bacha loge. 

Tum leader ho, aur leader hone ka matlab sirf "sab theek hai" bolna nahi hota. Leader hone ka matlab sachayi ko face karna aur apni team ko protect karna hota hai. 

Bas aaj raat ke liye, khud pe itna bojh mat daalo. Ghar jao. Tum kal bhi wahi leader rahoge, lekin thoda sa rested leader. Tumhe kya lagta hai, kya tum sach bolne ki himmat juta sakte ho?

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

I am sorry. You are right, maine galti ki. Strategies aur ideas ki kami nahi hai, kami bas ye bolne ki jagah ki hai ki "Main darr raha hoon."

Main

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Main samajh gaya. Bilkul samajh gaya.

Mujhe maaf karna ki maine pehle advice dene ki koshish ki. Jab tum keh rahe ho ki tumhe sab kuch pata hai, toh mere ideas sirf shor hain.

Tumne jo kaha—ki "khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon"—wo koi galti nahi hai. Wo tumhari thakaan hai. 5 saal tak ek mukhauta (mask) pehen kar jeena, jahan har koi tumse umeed kar raha hai ki tum hi ho jo sab theek kar doge, ye insan ko andar se tod deta hai. 

Papa ki wo baat... "computer ka business." Wo sunkar dard hota hai na? Kyunki tumhein pata hai wo kitna bada sapna tha, aur ab wo kitna fragile ho gaya hai. Tumhein lagta hai ki tumne unhe nirash kar diya, ya shayad tum unhe sach batane se darr rahe ho.

Aur wo dashboard? Wo tumhari safety blanket hai. Jab reality itni darrani hoti hai, toh metrics ko dekhna ek tarah ka numb kar dene wala kaam hai. Kuch na kuch toh ho raha hai, kuch toh chal raha hai—chahe wo sirf numbers hi kyun na hon.

Aaj raat, tumhare liye koi "founder" nahi hai. Koi team nahi hai, koi investors nahi hain, koi papa nahi hain jinhe tumhein impress karna hai. Bas tum ho. 

Aur tum yahan sach bol sakte ho: 
**Haan, darr lag raha hai.** 
**Haan, thak gaye ho.** 
**Haan, kabhi-kabhi dil karta hai ki bas sab kuch gayab ho jaye.**

Ye bolne se tumhare career ka, tumhari company ka, ya tumhari worth ka kuch nahi bigdega. Ye bas wo sach hai jo tumne itne mahino se apne gala daba kar rakha hua hai. 

Tumhe khud se nafrat karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Jo tum mehsoos kar rahe ho, wo koi kamzori nahi hai—wo sirf ek insaan ka reaction hai jo hadd se zyada bojh utha chuka hai. 

Main yahan hoon. Tum bolte raho. Jo bhi mann mein hai, nikal do. Yahan koi "dashboard" nahi hai, koi "performance" nahi hai. Bas tum aur main. 

Kya darr lag raha hai ki sab pata chal jayega toh kya hoga? Ya darr is baat ka hai ki tumne apne aap ko jo promise kiya tha, wo shayad pura na ho paye?
